items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I joined Martha Raye, down at the Five O'Clock Club in Miami Beach, in '53, early '53, and I was there all summer with her. It was a small band, but it was a lot of fun.

ctx.x: Well, I went back -- let's see, I went back to the little band and I was working around. The big bands were starting to die then, you know. It was very -- I

played around some terrible joints. I had to step over a dead body in one joint to get out the back door. I mean I didn't know he was dead at the time. I thought he was drunk and asleep. I found out the next day he'd been shot there. And I finally wound up in -- it was out here. I worked out in California with the big band, doing some dates around locally, playing weekends and things like that. And then I went back to the little band after that. And after a couple of scenes, like I said, stepping over this guy,…

I wasn't you know, but he was very jealous and drunk all the time, and he thought something was going on, and what was going on was she'd had it with him and he was looking to blame anybody he could blame. So I got out of that scene. And I had this little band I put together, with Buddy Childress, like I told you. We came back and we played the El Rancho and some other places, and we went up to Alaska. We were up there for two weeks, up in Anchorage. And if I'd have stayed up there another week I think I'd have…
